description:
This requirement is for Wireless Internet and Mobile services in support of Commander, Task Group 73.2 (CTG 73-2) in Guam.

See attached Solicitation N6264926QH017 for details. For submittal instructions, refer to Addendum to 52.212-1,Instructions to Offerors, on Page 18. Please direct any questions via email to Joshua Tyquiengco at joshua.g.tyquiengco.civ@us.navy.mil AND Rafael Battung at rafaeleladio.m.battung.civ@us.navy.mil by 0900 am ChST (Guam Time) on Monday, March 16, 2026.

Amendment 0001:  The purpose of this amendment is to include Attachment (B) Q & A to provide a government response to a request for information. The due date and time of offers remain the same (17MAR26 at 900 JST/ 1000 ChST).
